name: Aboleth
summary: An ancient aquatic aberration that grapples with tentacles, devours memories, and dominates minds telepathically.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Eldritch Restoration
traits.text: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in 5d10 days, reviving with all its {ref:glossary/hit-points} in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the GM.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance
traits.text: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Mucus Cloud
traits.text: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. *Constitution Saving Throw:* {dc:con}, each creature in a 5-foot {ref:glossary/emanation} originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. *Failure:* The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} unless it is underwater. While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes {dmg:1d12:acid} at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

traits.name: Probing Telepathy
traits.text: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The aboleth makes two Tentacle attacks and uses either Consume Memories or Dominate Mind if available.

actions.name: Tentacle
actions.onHit: If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc=14}) from one of four tentacles.

actions.name: Consume Memories

save.targets: one creature within 30 feet that is Charmed or Grappled by the aboleth

actions.onFailureOrSuccess: The aboleth gains the target's memories if the target is a Humanoid and is reduced to 0 {ref:glossary/hit-points} by this action.

actions.name: Dominate Mind

save.targets: one creature the aboleth can see within 30 feet

actions.onFailure: The target has the {ref:condition/charmed} condition until the aboleth dies or is on a different plane of existence from the target. While {ref:condition/charmed}, the target acts as an ally to the aboleth and is under its control while within 60 feet of it. In addition, the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The target repeats the save whenever it takes damage as well as after every 24 hours it spends at least 1 mile away from the aboleth, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendaryActions.intro: Immediately after another creature's turn, the aboleth can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The aboleth regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.

items.name: Lash
items.text: The aboleth makes one Tentacle attack.

items.name: Psychic Drain
items.text: If the aboleth has at least one creature {ref:condition/charmed} or {ref:condition/grappled}, it uses Consume Memories and regains {dmg:1d10} {ref:glossary/hit-points}.
